reply_text:
Three of the five build-loop problems have landed. The topology loops look stuck cycling on one row each, so I'm checking that.In the four hours since your last message, the build loop closed three of its five problems, and the two topology loops made no progress at all, so I've stopped them.

**Build loop (still running):**

| Problem | State | Attempts this run |
|---|---|---|
| m94J02 | proved and committed (48481c05) | 4 |
| m03J05 | proved and committed (7fddcb6f) | 24 |
| m95J02 | proved and committed (80a1e24a) | 15 |
| m02J02 | still open | 41, all four strategy passes used |
| m96J03 | still open, on the corrected statement | 20, two strategy passes |

- All three proofs passed the loop's check: no `sorry`, standard axioms only, statement unchanged.
- Each of the three had been stopped earlier for missing Mathlib theory. No strategy pass in this run has said stop.
- m02J02 reaches the 50-attempt cap in nine more attempts, and I haven't looked at whether its 41 attempts are building anything.

**Topology loops (stopped at 08:20):** each spent the whole four hours repeating the same two steps on a single row, about 70 times per loop. The author stops, the reviewer fails it, and the loop sends it back to the author.
- **topo1**, on the t98a06 part (a) adapter: the row depends on a third submersion-lift attempt that needs to be marked superseded in the worklist. The author's row isn't allowed to edit the worklist, so it stops every time and says so.
- **topo2**, on the t94a08 affine-chart row: the loop turns an author "stop" back into "awaiting review". The reviewer then fails it because there is no commit to review. The reviewer also says the row's contract is about real projective space while the work is complex projective.

Neither repair is done. Both are worklist edits the seats have already spelled out, plus a change to the loop so a stopped row isn't sent for review. I should make those before restarting either loop.

- **Codex usage:** the newest session file reads 72% on the primary limit, and the topology cycling was part of that.
- **Unpushed commits:** apm-lean master is 20 commits ahead of origin, including the three new proofs. Should I push them?
